```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dev = "png", dpi = 120)
library(ggplot2)
qa <- params$qa
S <- qa$settings
an <- S$analytes

ink <- "#0b0b0b"; ink2 <- "#52514e"; muted <- "#898781"; grid_col <- "#e1e0d9"; surface <- "#fcfcfb"
analyte_cols <- stats::setNames(c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300")[seq_along(an)], an)
context_grey <- "#c3c2b7"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) %+replace%
    theme(text = element_text(colour = ink2),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = surface, colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = grid_col, linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = ink, face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(4, 0, 4, 0)),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = muted),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, colour = muted),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11, colour = ink2, hjust = 0, margin = margin(0, 0, 6, 0)),
          plot.title.position = "plot"))

tbl <- function(d, ...) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(cat("<p class='none'>None found.</p>\n"))
  cat(knitr::kable(d, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE,
                   table.attr = "class='table table-condensed qa'", ...))
}
none <- function(msg = "None found.") cat("<p class='none'>", msg, "</p>\n")
show_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible())
  tryCatch(print(p), error = function(e)
    cat("<p class='note'>Plot skipped: ", htmltools::htmlEscape(conditionMessage(e)), "</p>\n"))
}
fmt <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
short_plate <- function(x) sub("\\.xlsx$", "", x)
short_id <- function(x) sub("^[A-Za-z]+_", "", x)
esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape

# x positions: other stimulants as single dots, then each dose series from its reference well
pos_plot <- local({
  stims <- setdiff(S$stims, "lps")
  out <- data.frame(condition = stims, x = seq_along(stims), line = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  xx <- length(stims)
  blocks <- lapply(S$dose_series, function(s) c(s$reference, names(sort(s$doses))))
  if (!length(blocks) && "lps" %in% S$expected_conditions) blocks <- list(lps = "lps")
  for (nm in names(blocks)) {
    cs <- blocks[[nm]]
    if (xx > 0) xx <- xx + 0.5
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(condition = cs, x = xx + seq_along(cs), line = nm, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    xx <- xx + length(cs)
  }
  out
})
cond_order <- unique(c("us", pos_plot$condition))
plan <- qa$plan
plan_text <- function(r) {
  if (!nrow(r)) return("")
  w <- ifelse(r$action == "ignore us", "", sub("^[0-9]+_V[0-9]+_", "", short_id(r$id)))
  na_w <- w[r$action == "na"]
  na_w <- na_w[order(match(na_w, c(cond_order, setdiff(na_w, cond_order))))]
  a <- c(if (any(r$action == "keep")) "leave as is",
         if (any(r$action == "use other us")) paste0("use the us from ", short_id(r$from[r$action == "use other us"][1]),
                                                     " (", S$repeats_sheet, " row ", r$from_row[r$action == "use other us"][1], ")"),
         if (any(r$action == "ignore us")) "ignore us",
         if (length(na_w)) paste(paste(na_w, collapse = ", "), "NA"))
  paste0(paste(unique(a), collapse = "; "), " (", paste(unique(ifelse(r$set_by == "you", "set by you", "default")), collapse = ", "), ")")
}
```

# Tagged participants

```{r detail_fun}
# x positions for the cytokine production charts: lps, r848, hsp60
pos_prod <- data.frame(condition = intersect(c("lps", "r848", "hsp60"), S$stims), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pos_prod$x <- seq_len(nrow(pos_prod)); pos_prod$line <- NA_character_

measured_plot <- function(v, p, pos = pos_plot) {
  pv <- merge(expand.grid(condition = pos$condition, analyte = an, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
              v[, c("condition", "analyte", "mfi")], all.x = TRUE)
  pv <- pv[!duplicated(pv[, c("condition", "analyte")]), ]
  pv <- merge(pos, pv, by = "condition")
  pv <- pv[order(pv$analyte, pv$x), ]
  right <- max(pos$x) + if (nrow(pos) > 4) 0.45 else 0.6
  us <- v[v$condition == "us" & !is.na(v$mfi), c("analyte", "mfi")]
  us$x <- right
  other <- data.frame(analyte = character(0), mfi = numeric(0), x = numeric(0))
  from <- plan$from_row[plan$participant == p & plan$action == "use other us"]
  if (length(from) && !is.null(qa$alt_us)) {
    other <- qa$alt_us[qa$alt_us$excel_row == from[1] & !is.na(qa$alt_us$mfi), c("analyte", "mfi")]
    other$x <- right
  }
  ggplot(pv, aes(x, mfi, colour = analyte)) +
    geom_hline(data = other, aes(yintercept = mfi, colour = analyte), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = other, aes(x = x, y = mfi, label = "other US"), colour = ink2, size = 3, vjust = -0.4) +
    geom_hline(data = us, aes(yintercept = mfi, colour = analyte), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = us, aes(x = x, y = mfi, label = "US"), colour = ink2, size = 3, vjust = -0.4) +
    geom_line(data = pv[!is.na(pv$line) & !is.na(pv$mfi), ], aes(group = interaction(analyte, line)), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = pv[!is.na(pv$mfi), ], size = 2.4, shape = 21, fill = surface, stroke = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = analyte_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos$x, labels = pos$condition,
                       limits = c(min(pos$x) - 0.3, right + 0.3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.12))) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) + facet_wrap(~ analyte, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "MFI", title = "raw mfi")
}

scored_plot <- function(p) {
  sc <- qa$scored[qa$scored$id_num == p, ]
  pv <- merge(pos_plot, sc, by = "condition")
  pv <- pv[order(pv$analyte, pv$x), ]
  sl <- qa$slopes[qa$slopes$id_num == p, ]
  fit <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(pv[!is.na(pv$line), ], list(pv$analyte[!is.na(pv$line)], pv$line[!is.na(pv$line)]), drop = TRUE), function(g) {
    g <- g[order(g$x), ]; ok <- !is.na(g$after)
    if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NULL)
    m <- stats::lm(after ~ x, g[ok, ])
    data.frame(analyte = g$analyte[1], line = g$line[1], x = range(g$x[ok]),
               y = stats::predict(m, data.frame(x = range(g$x[ok]))), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  lab <- if (nrow(sl)) {
    txt <- ifelse(is.na(sl$after), sprintf("%s line slope %s, after plan NA", sl$series, fmt(sl$before, 2)),
                  ifelse(!any(plan$participant == p & plan$action != "keep"), sprintf("%s line slope %s", sl$series, fmt(sl$after, 2)),
                         sprintf("%s line slope %s, after plan %s", sl$series, fmt(sl$before, 2), fmt(sl$after, 2))))
    stats::aggregate(txt ~ analyte, data.frame(analyte = sl$analyte, txt = txt), paste, collapse = "\n")
  } else data.frame(analyte = character(0), txt = character(0))
  changed <- !is.na(pv$before) & (is.na(pv$after) | abs(pv$before - pv$after) > 1e-9)
  na_wells <- unique(pv[!is.na(pv$before) & is.na(pv$after), c("analyte", "x")])
  g <- ggplot(pv, aes(x, after, colour = analyte))
  if (any(changed))
    g <- g + geom_line(data = pv[!is.na(pv$line) & !is.na(pv$before), ], aes(x, before, group = interaction(analyte, line)),
                       colour = context_grey, linewidth = 0.7) +
      geom_point(data = pv[changed, ], aes(x, before), colour = context_grey, size = 1.8)
  if (!is.null(fit) && nrow(fit)) g <- g + geom_line(data = fit, aes(x, y, group = interaction(analyte, line)), linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.7)
  g + geom_line(data = pv[!is.na(pv$line) & !is.na(pv$after), ], aes(group = interaction(analyte, line)), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = pv[!is.na(pv$after), ], size = 2.4, shape = 21, fill = surface, stroke = 0.7) +
    geom_text(data = na_wells, aes(x = x, y = -Inf, label = "NA"), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = ink2, size = 2.8, vjust = -0.5) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(x = max(pos_plot$x) + 0.6, y = Inf, label = txt), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              colour = ink2, size = 3, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, lineheight = 0.95) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = analyte_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_plot$x, labels = pos_plot$condition,
                       limits = c(min(pos_plot$x) - 0.3, max(pos_plot$x) + 0.7)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) + facet_wrap(~ analyte, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "ln(MFI - US + 1)", title = "inhibition slope, after scoring")
}

composite_plot <- function(p) {
  cp <- merge(pos_prod, qa$composites[qa$composites$id_num == p, ], by = "condition")
  if (!nrow(cp) || all(is.na(cp$before) & is.na(cp$after))) return(NULL)
  cp <- cp[order(cp$x), ]
  na_after <- cp[is.na(cp$after) & !is.na(cp$before), ]
  ggplot(cp, aes(x)) +
    geom_line(data = cp[!is.na(cp$before), ], aes(y = before), colour = context_grey, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = cp[!is.na(cp$before), ], aes(y = before), colour = context_grey, size = 2.2) +
    geom_line(data = cp[!is.na(cp$after), ], aes(y = after), colour = "#2a78d6", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = cp[!is.na(cp$after), ], aes(y = after), colour = "#2a78d6", fill = surface, shape = 21, size = 2.6, stroke = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = na_after, aes(y = -Inf, label = "NA"), colour = ink2, size = 2.8, vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_prod$x, labels = pos_prod$condition, limits = c(0.7, max(pos_prod$x) + 0.3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, colour = muted)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "composite (z)", title = "cytokine production, after scoring")
}

values_table <- function(v, p, keep = NULL) {
  conds <- unique(v$condition)
  if (!is.null(keep)) conds <- intersect(conds, keep)
  conds <- conds[order(match(conds, c(cond_order, setdiff(conds, cond_order))))]
  get <- function(a, what) { r <- v[v$analyte == a, ]; r[match(conds, r$condition), what] }
  conc_txt <- function(raw) {
    raw <- trimws(as.character(raw)); num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw))
    ifelse(is.na(raw) | raw == "", "", ifelse(is.na(num), raw, fmt(num, 2)))
  }
  w <- data.frame(condition = conds, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "MFI")]] <- fmt(get(a, "mfi"), 0)
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "conc")]] <- conc_txt(get(a, "conc_raw"))
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "CV%")]] <- fmt(get(a, "cv"), 1)
  from <- plan$from_row[plan$participant == p & plan$action == "use other us"]
  if (length(from) && !is.null(qa$alt_us)) {                # the other US run, as an extra row
    o <- qa$alt_us[qa$alt_us$excel_row == from[1], ]
    og <- function(a, what) o[[what]][match(a, o$analyte)]
    ow <- data.frame(condition = paste0(sub("^[A-Za-z]+_[0-9]+_V[0-9]+_", "", o$id[1]), " (", S$repeats_sheet, " row ", from[1], ")"),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (a in an) ow[[paste(a, "MFI")]] <- fmt(og(a, "mfi"), 0)
    for (a in an) ow[[paste(a, "conc")]] <- conc_txt(og(a, "conc_raw"))
    for (a in an) ow[[paste(a, "CV%")]] <- fmt(og(a, "cv"), 1)
    w <- rbind(w, ow)
  }
  tbl(w)
}

panel_head <- function(p, v) {
  cat("\n\n## ", p, " {.participant}\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(v)) cat(sprintf("<p class='note'>Plate: %s</p>\n", esc(paste(unique(short_plate(stats::na.omit(v$plate))), collapse = "; "))))
  il <- fhrc:::.lpq_issue_lines(qa$problems[qa$problems$participant == p, ], S)
  items <- c(if (nrow(il)) paste0("<li><b>", esc(il$issue), ":</b> ", esc(il$detail), "</li>"),
             paste0("<li><b>plan:</b> ", esc(if (any(plan$participant == p)) plan_text(plan[plan$participant == p, ]) else "nothing to change"), "</li>"))
  cat("<ul>", paste(items, collapse = ""), "</ul>\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r tagged, results = "asis", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 3.6}
ids <- qa$tagged
if (!length(ids)) none("None found.") else
  cat("<p class='note'>top row graphs are as measured, whereas second row graphs are with us subtracted, negative values imputed to 0, and then +1 and natural log transformed. when cytokine production (lps, r848, hsp60) is affected, a third row graph shows each stimulant's standardized composite as in scoring: the second row values z-scored within each stimulant and cytokine across all participants, then averaged across cytokines. in each, the colored line is with the plan, and the grey line is without the plan.</p>\n")
for (p in ids) {
  v <- qa$values[qa$values$id_num == p, ]
  panel_head(p, v)
  if (!nrow(v) || all(is.na(v$mfi))) { cat("<p class='note'>No values for this participant.</p>\n"); next }
  show_plot(measured_plot(v, p))
  show_plot(scored_plot(p))
  if (p %in% qa$tagged_production) show_plot(composite_plot(p))
  values_table(v, p)
}
```

# Plan summary

```{r plan, results = "asis"}
if (!nrow(plan)) {
  none("Nothing to change.")
} else {
  d <- data.frame(
    participant = plan$participant,
    action = ifelse(plan$action == "keep", "leave as is", plan$action),
    well = ifelse(plan$action == "keep", "",
                  ifelse(plan$action == "use other us", paste0(short_id(plan$id), " from ", S$repeats_sheet, " row ", plan$from_row), short_id(plan$id))),
    `set by` = plan$set_by, why = plan$why, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  tbl(d)
  if (any(plan$action == "use other us"))
    cat(sprintf("<p class='note'><b>use other us</b>: another run of the US well in the '%s' sheet removes the US problems, so its values are used instead (only proposed by default when it does).</p>\n", esc(S$repeats_sheet)))
  cat("<p class='note'>To change a participant's plan, run again listing them in <code>na</code>, <code>ignore_us</code>, <code>use_other_us</code> or <code>keep</code>. What you list replaces the default for that participant.</p>\n")
}
if (!is.null(S$export_file)) {
  cat(sprintf("<p>Data with this plan applied saved to <code>%s</code>.</p>\n", esc(S$export_file)))
} else {
  cat("<p class='note'>Data not exported yet. Once the plan is final, run again with <code>export = TRUE</code>.</p>\n")
}
```

## Some rule notes

```{r rules, results = "asis"}
k <- min(S$dip_cytokines, length(an))
fold_lab <- paste0(S$inhibitor_fold, "x")
rules <- c(
  sprintf("<b>sus 0</b>: a well comes out as 0 after scoring in at least %d cytokines, either because it is about 0 as measured (%s MFI or less) or because it is below US.", k, S$zero_mfi),
  sprintf("<b>non-zero us large cv</b>: the US replicates' CV is above %s%% in a cytokine where US is at least %s MFI (low US values often have large CVs and are not counted).", S$us_cv, S$us_min),
  sprintf("<b>sus dose-response</b>: one dose well is more than %s below (dip) or above (spike) both neighbouring doses on the ln scale, in at least %d cytokines.", S$dip_size, k),
  "<b>line slope</b>: the slope scores before and after plan are just lm, not the extracted slopes from mlm models.",
  sprintf("<b>crt &gt; %s lps</b> (and il10): an inhibitor well reads more than %s the LPS well in at least %d cytokines.", fold_lab, fold_lab, k),
  sprintf("<b>Default plan</b>: a well about 0 as measured is set to NA; for a US problem, another US run from the '%s' sheet is used if it removes the US problems, otherwise US is ignored (two or more wells below US, or a non-zero US with a large CV) or the one well below US is set to NA; a dose-response dip or spike is set to NA; inhibitor wells above %s LPS set LPS to NA, and if they still rise with dose they are set to NA too.",
          if (is.null(S$repeats_sheet)) "for master" else S$repeats_sheet, fold_lab))
cat("<ul class='note'>", paste0("<li>", rules, "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>\n", sep = "")
```
